entities.name: PMID:10735611
observations: Double-blind acute hemodynamic study; 20 cirrhotic patients with grade II–III esophageal varices, 14 treated with terlipressin 2 mg IV and 6 with placebo; measurements repeated at 60 minutes. J Hepatol. 2000;32:105–111.

entities.name: Terlipressin pressure effect
observations: At 60 minutes, terlipressin reduced intravariceal pressure 21±16% and HVPG 14±12%; variceal gradient fell 28±27%. Acute findings suggest a greater decrease in variceal pressure than portal pressure in this small study.
